subject: Renewal + private offer uplift — proposed schedule & docs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + private offer uplift — proposed schedule & docs

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, Asteria’s renewal window is coming up and you flagged interest in a near-term capacity uplift via a private offer so you can avoid re-procurement friction while preserving marketplace billing. Attached are: a short MRR projection I pulled together and a draft private-offer we can submit to AWS once you confirm.

High-level ask / next steps:
- Could you confirm target uplift % and whether finance needs a single PO or tranches?
- If single PO, target sign date you’re aiming for (you mentioned mid-June).
- We can stagger acceptance to match invoicing cadence (monthly tranches vs. single acceptance) — let us know preference.

Proposed schedule (tentative):
- 5/3: Share documents & draft private-offer
- 5/4–5/11: Procurement questions / PO template returned
- 5/12–5/16: Redwood submits private-offer to AWS marketplace ops
- 6/1–6/15: Acceptance + invoice cutover (target)

Attachments: Asteria_MRR_projection.xlsx, Draft_Private_Offer_Proposal.pdf

If it helps, we can schedule a quick 30-min call with marketplace ops in the next week to walk process and timelines.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415‑555‑0139

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@asteriahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@asteriahealth.com
Date: 2026-05-04T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + private offer uplift — proposed schedule & docs

Marissa —

Thanks for the materials, this is helpful. Quick answers:
- Uplift: we’re targeting a 15% uplift to cover expected Q3 usage spikes.
- Procurement prefers a single PO if possible, but finance may ask to split the first invoice into two tranches for recognition. I’ll confirm.
- Target sign date: procurement is planning to sign by 2026-06-15 if we can get the private-offer in this month.

Procurement attached our PO template (Asteria_PO_template.pdf). Two outstanding asks from my side:
1) Can you confirm the invoice cadence and whether Redwood can produce an itemized invoice matching marketplace acceptance (we need it for our AP team)?
2) We’ll need SOC 2 evidence and an updated data processing addendum on file before finance will approve.

Looping in procurement on next steps. Please include marketplace ops contact so our vendor desk can validate acceptance windows.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director, Cloud Platform & Integrations
Asteria Health
elena@asteriahealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@asteriahealth.com>, marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + private offer uplift — proposed schedule & docs

Hi Elena / AWS ops —

Thanks Elena — noted on the 15% uplift and single-PO preference. Priyom here from marketplace team at Redwood. A few operational details to confirm so we can meet the mid-June sign target:

1) Acceptance model: we typically submit a private-offer with staged acceptance (you can accept the full amount at once or in two acceptance events to match recognition). If procurement wants the first invoice split, we can request acceptance in two tranches.

2) Invoice cadence: Redwood will provide itemized invoices tied to acceptance events; we can also provide a CSV export for your AP team.

3) Evidence: SOC2 report and DPA — Marissa, I’ll attach the latest SOC2 and DPA to the private-offer packet. Elena, can procurement confirm whether they need a redacted report or full audit?

AWS ops — can you confirm estimated SLA for private-offer processing and any blackout dates in May that could push acceptance into late June? Ideally we submit by 5/16 to leave cushion.

Attachments: Acceptance_Checklist.pdf

If AWS ops needs a specific file format for the PO, please advise — we can convert to marketplace template.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference
